name: Queen's Park Oval
summary: Queen's Park Oval hosts five Trinbago Knight Riders fixtures during the CPL 2026 Trinidad leg.
tagline: One of the Caribbean's best-known cricket grounds in the heart of Port of Spain.
ends: Brian Lara Pavilion End and Media Centre End
home_team: Trinidad and Tobago Red Force and Trinbago Knight Riders
story: Queen's Park Oval is a historic international cricket venue in Port of Spain and the home of the Queen's Park Cricket Club.
The ground has staged Test, one-day international, T20 international and Caribbean Premier League cricket across several eras.
Five Trinbago Knight Riders league matches are scheduled at the Oval in 2026, including a 5pm fixture on 31 August.

highlights.text: The Oval sits close to the city's main commercial and entertainment districts.

highlights.label: History
highlights.title: Established in 1896
highlights.text: It is one of the longest-serving major cricket venues in the Caribbean.

highlights.text: The Trinidad block runs from 26 August to 2 September.
